research_grounding.CADEC: CSIRO Adverse Drug Event Corpus — colloquial forum ADE spans; used here as curated surface→PT patterns (not redistributed CADEC files)
research_grounding.SMM4H: Social Media Mining for Health — slang / emoji / typo calibration lexicon
research_grounding.PharmaCoNER: Pharmacological NER — substance span patterns for noisy clinical/social text
research_grounding.MicroMeSH: Historical synonym / abbreviation fuzzy keys for Biomedical Entity Linking
research_grounding.BEL: Biomedical Entity Linking to UMLS-style CUIs (surrogate CUI-SUR-* / curated anchors)
research_grounding.RxNorm: NIH RxNorm REST (keyless, optional online) for Brand→Ingredient
research_grounding.RxE: RxNorm Extension-style international / discontinued brand→ingredient table (offline)
research_grounding.RxClass: RxClass / ATC linkage via local ATC tree + optional RxClass API

disclaimer: Open teaching surrogates for an offline-first prototype. Not licensed UMLS, MedDRA, full RxNorm/RxE dumps, CADEC, SMM4H, or PharmaCoNER redistribution. Not for regulatory submission or clinical use.
